items.title: What AGs will be looking at in Meta's latest social media addiction trial
items.summary: A coalition of US state attorneys general is bringing forth a new case against tech giant Meta Platforms (META), citing how its various social media platforms are designed to be addictive toward younger and teenage users. The trial is set to start this Tuesday, August 18. Axios tech policy reporter Maria Curi comes on Market Domination to outline what courts will be focusing on in this latest court case.
